uncertain_items.item: For 5x+3y=-19 and 9x-2y=25, the source states that multiplying only one equation will not help. That unrestricted assertion is false for fractional multipliers.
uncertain_items.verified_counterexample: Multiply the first equation by 2/3: (10/3)x+2y=-38/3. Add the unchanged second equation to get (37/3)x=37/3, giving x=1,y=-8.
uncertain_items.source_method: Multiplying the first equation by 2 and the second by 3 is correct and keeps integer coefficients.
uncertain_items.handling: App instruction explicitly identifies the whole-number strategy and explains that a suitable fractional one-equation multiplier is also valid. The source conflict is disclosed rather than silently repaired.
uncertain_items.resolution_required: Source editorial clarification of the unrestricted claim before full SOURCE_VERIFIED status.

response_format_adaptations.source_format: Translate into an equation, then solve the age problem
response_format_adaptations.handling: Five numeric fields construct the expanded canonical equation Ax+B=Cx+D and record current age. Left side is older future age; right side is the source-stated multiple of younger future age. Equation construction is retained; no app-authored equation-choice recognition task substitutes for it. All five fields share two credit-bearing submissions and one possible point.
